cohort: The study included 50 premenopausal women aged 20-50 years with pathologically proven ovarian fibroma/fibrothecoma who underwent ovarian-sparing local mass excision.
finding: Ovarian-sparing local mass excision resulted in a 2% recurrence rate of ovarian fibroma/fibrothecoma and a high natural conception rate (11 of 12 pregnancies) in premenopausal women.
